title: mattpocock/skills
claim: mattpocock/skills — Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
why_good: The project addresses a specific gap in skill assessment for engineers, which is often overlooked in traditional hiring processes.
value: Companies could pay for subscription access to a platform that provides tailored skill assessments and training modules for their engineering teams.
risk: The market for skill assessment tools is competitive, and established players could easily integrate similar features into their existing platforms.
